blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解過濾器完整性測試 (Filter Integrity Testing) 的資料關鍵性如何隨測試目的（使用後確認 vs. 使用前確認 vs. 身份驗證）而改變，並能對應到 9-Box 網格的不同象限。
blocks.en: Understand how the data criticality of filter integrity testing changes with the purpose of the test (post-use confirmation vs. pre-use confirmation vs. identity verification), and map each case to the appropriate cell of the 9-Box grid.

blocks.zh: 能夠辨識紙本記錄、半自動化與端對端自動化三個層次的資料弱點 (Data Vulnerability)，並說明每個層次的控制措施如何影響最終弱點等級。
blocks.en: Be able to identify the data vulnerability at three levels (paper records, semi-automated, and end-to-end automated), and explain how the controls at each level affect the final vulnerability rating.

blocks.zh: 以藥錠二次包裝 (Tablet Packaging) 的七個製造操作為例，分析計畫、領料、生產線清線、設備設置、包裝、製程控制及批次核對各步驟的 DI 風險來源與改善方向。
blocks.en: Using the seven manufacturing operations of tablet secondary packaging as the example, analyze the sources of DI risk and the improvement directions for planning, dispensing, line clearance, equipment setup, packaging, in-process control and batch reconciliation.

blocks.zh: 將本節案例的 DI 控制思維應用於自身 CDMO 的無菌充填或包裝現場，識別高優先級的弱點改善機會。
blocks.en: Apply the DI control thinking of this section to your own CDMO's aseptic filling or packaging floor, and identify high-priority opportunities to reduce vulnerability.

blocks.zh: Sterility Assurance Examples — Overview / 無菌保證案例概述
blocks.en: Sterility Assurance Examples — Overview

blocks.zh: 中文解說
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心架構：為何過濾器完整性測試是 DI 高風險區？
blocks.en: Core framework: why is filter integrity testing a high-risk area for DI?

blocks.zh: 無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance) 的最後一道防線是滅菌過濾器。如果過濾器完整性測試 (Filter Integrity Testing) 的資料遭到竄改或隱瞞，缺陷過濾器可能讓微生物污染流入最終產品——患者直接承受風險。
blocks.en: The sterilizing filter is the last line of defense for sterility assurance. If the data from filter integrity testing are falsified or concealed, a defective filter could allow microbial contamination into the final product, and the patient bears the risk directly.

blocks.zh: TR84 用三個平行案例（Ex7 / Ex8 / Ex9）展示同一個測試行為，因「目的不同」而產生不同的資料關鍵性，這是 9-Box 框架最精妙的示範之一。
blocks.en: TR84 uses three parallel cases (Ex7 / Ex8 / Ex9) to show that the same test activity carries different data criticality depending on its purpose. This is one of the most elegant demonstrations of the 9-Box framework.

blocks.zh: Ex7（使用後）：確認無菌充填後過濾器沒有被破壞 → 影響 CQA → 高關鍵性
blocks.en: Ex7 (post-use): confirms the filter was not compromised after aseptic filling → affects CQAs → high criticality

blocks.zh: Ex8（使用前、滅菌後）：確認過濾器在無菌充填前完好 → 法規建議而非要求（美國）→ 中關鍵性
blocks.en: Ex8 (pre-use, post-sterilization): confirms the filter is intact before aseptic filling → recommended rather than required by regulators (US) → medium criticality

blocks.zh: Ex9（使用前、滅菌前）：確認安裝了正確的過濾器型號 → 非法規要求 → 低關鍵性
blocks.en: Ex9 (pre-use, pre-sterilization): confirms the correct filter type has been installed → not a regulatory requirement → low criticality

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛機落地後的輪胎檢查 vs. 起飛前的確認
blocks.en: Analogy: the tire check after an aircraft lands vs. the check before takeoff

blocks.zh: 使用後完整性測試（Ex7）就像飛機降落後強制檢查輪胎是否爆胎——這是確認「整趟飛行是否安全」的最終證明，法規強制要求，資料關鍵性最高。使用前測試（Ex8）像起飛前再確認輪胎氣壓，是好習慣但不是所有地區強制要求。安裝確認（Ex9）像確認輪胎型號與型錄相符，屬於身份驗證，最低關鍵性。
blocks.en: Post-use integrity testing (Ex7) is like the mandatory tire inspection after landing to see whether a tire has burst: it is the final proof that the whole flight was safe, it is required by regulation, and its data criticality is the highest. Pre-use testing (Ex8) is like re-checking tire pressure before takeoff: good practice, but not mandatory in every region. Installation confirmation (Ex9) is like checking that the tire model matches the catalog: it is identity verification and has the lowest criticality.

blocks.zh: 監管差異提醒
blocks.en: Regulatory difference to keep in mind

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA 只要求使用後測試；歐盟 Annex 1 要求使用前和使用後都必須確認過濾器完整性。因此 Ex8 在歐盟廠房的關鍵性可能提升為高關鍵性。CDMO 同時服務 FDA 與 EMA 客戶時，必須以最嚴格的要求為基準設計資料控制。
blocks.en: The US FDA requires only post-use testing, whereas EU Annex 1 requires filter integrity to be confirmed both before and after use. Ex8 may therefore rise to high criticality at an EU site. A CDMO serving both FDA and EMA clients must design its data controls to the most stringent requirement.

blocks.zh: 應用於您的 CDMO
blocks.en: Applying this to your CDMO

blocks.zh: 盤點您廠區所有過濾器完整性測試儀：哪些是舊式設備（僅紙本列印）？哪些已有電子資料儲存與稽核軌跡？根據本節框架，舊式設備搭配高關鍵性操作（使用後測試）最優先需要升級。
blocks.en: Take an inventory of every filter integrity tester on site: which are legacy units (paper printout only), and which already have electronic data storage and audit trails? Under the framework in this section, legacy equipment combined with a high-criticality operation (post-use testing) is the first priority for upgrade.

blocks.zh: Example 7: High Criticality – Filter Integrity Testing (Post-Use) / 高關鍵性：使用後過濾器完整性測試
blocks.en: Example 7: High Criticality – Filter Integrity Testing (Post-Use)

blocks.zh: DI 問題與管控演進：從紙本到端對端自動化
blocks.en: The DI problem and the evolution of controls: from paper to end-to-end automation

blocks.zh: Example 7 是本節最核心的示範——同一個高關鍵性操作，因技術層次不同，弱點等級從 Significant（顯著）降至 Acceptable（可接受）。
blocks.en: Example 7 is the central demonstration of this section: for the same high-criticality operation, the vulnerability rating falls from Significant to Acceptable as the level of technology increases.

blocks.zh: 7a（紙本列印）：操作員手動轉錄設置資料 + 舊式儀器無電子儲存能力 → 兩個高弱點因子疊加 → Significant。這是許多老廠的現況。
blocks.en: 7a (paper printout): the operator manually transcribes setup data + the legacy instrument has no electronic storage capability → two high-vulnerability factors stack up → Significant. This is the current state in many older sites.

blocks.zh: 7b（自動化資料擷取）：條碼讀取器自動填入設置資料 + 安全儲存模組 → 人為錯誤降至殘留水準 → Moderate。
blocks.en: 7b (automated data capture): a barcode reader populates the setup data automatically + a secure storage module → human error is reduced to a residual level → Moderate.

blocks.zh: 7c（全流程自動化）：過濾器在線測試，無需操作員手動啟動 + 結果自動傳輸至安全儲存 → 人為介入最小化 → Acceptable。
blocks.en: 7c (fully automated): the filter is tested in-line without the operator manually initiating the test + results are transferred automatically to secure storage → human intervention is minimized → Acceptable.

blocks.zh: 稽核重點：7a 的三大 DI 風險
blocks.en: Audit focus: the three major DI risks of 7a

blocks.zh: 手動轉錄錯誤：操作員將設置值手抄至記錄表，數字易誤記或故意篡改。
blocks.en: Manual transcription errors: operators copy setup values by hand into the record sheet, where numbers are easily mis-recorded or deliberately altered.

blocks.zh: 紙本列印易偽造：舊式儀器的列印紙可被替換；若無時間戳記，更難驗證原始性。
blocks.en: Paper printouts are easy to falsify: the printout from a legacy instrument can be swapped, and without a timestamp it is even harder to verify originality.

blocks.zh: 僅靠同儕審查：主管事後審查只能發現明顯異常，無法偵測刻意偽造的合格數據。
blocks.en: Reliance on peer review alone: after-the-fact supervisory review can detect only obvious anomalies, not a deliberately fabricated passing result.

blocks.zh: FDA 483 觀察項常見：「Filter integrity test records lack traceability to the original instrument output.」
blocks.en: A common FDA 483 observation: "Filter integrity test records lack traceability to the original instrument output."

blocks.zh: 比喻：手工填寫的行車記錄 vs. GPS 自動記錄
blocks.en: Analogy: a handwritten driving log vs. automatic GPS recording

blocks.zh: 7a 就像要求司機每小時手寫速度、里程——記錄可造假、易遺漏。7b 像行車電腦自動記錄但司機仍控制啟動。7c 像 GPS 全程自動追蹤，除非設備本身出問題，否則資料不可竄改。對於無菌充填這種高風險操作，只有 7c 等級的控制才能讓稽核員完全放心。
blocks.en: 7a is like requiring a driver to write down speed and mileage by hand every hour: the record can be faked or left incomplete. 7b is like a trip computer that records automatically while the driver still controls the start. 7c is like GPS tracking the entire trip automatically: unless the equipment itself fails, the data cannot be tampered with. For a high-risk operation such as aseptic filling, only 7c-level controls fully reassure an auditor.

blocks.zh: 思考問題
blocks.en: Question to consider

blocks.zh: 您廠區的過濾器完整性測試儀器屬於 7a、7b 還是 7c 層次？如果是 7a，主管的「事後審查」能否真正防止操作員偽造合格結果？若不能，下一步改善行動是什麼？
blocks.en: Is the filter integrity tester at your site at the 7a, 7b or 7c level? If it is 7a, can the supervisor's after-the-fact review really prevent an operator from falsifying a passing result? If not, what is the next improvement action?

blocks.zh: CDMO 改善路徑
blocks.en: CDMO improvement path

blocks.zh: 短期（無需換設備）：確保紙本列印貼附於批次記錄並由操作員簽名覆蓋，防止替換。中期：升級至有電子稽核軌跡的過濾器測試儀（7b 水準）。長期：評估在線整合（7c），特別是高產能或高批次頻率的產品線。
blocks.en: Short term (no new equipment): make sure the paper printout is attached to the batch record and overlaid with the operator's signature to prevent substitution. Medium term: upgrade to a filter tester with an electronic audit trail (7b level). Long term: evaluate in-line integration (7c), especially for high-throughput or high-batch-frequency product lines.

blocks.zh: Example 8: Medium Criticality – Filter Integrity Testing (Pre-Use, Post-Sterilization) / 中關鍵性：使用前（滅菌後）過濾器完整性測試
blocks.en: Example 8: Medium Criticality – Filter Integrity Testing (Pre-Use, Post-Sterilization)

blocks.zh: 中關鍵性如何影響弱點等級起點？
blocks.en: How does medium criticality shift the starting point of the vulnerability rating?

blocks.zh: 與 Ex7 比較，Ex8 的資料關鍵性從高降至中。這使得整個弱點評估向下偏移一級：
blocks.en: Compared with Ex7, the data criticality of Ex8 drops from high to medium. This shifts the whole vulnerability assessment down by one level:

blocks.zh: 相同的紙本列印情境（8a vs. 7a）：Ex8 得到 Moderate，而 Ex7 得到 Significant。
blocks.en: Same paper printout scenario (8a vs. 7a): Ex8 is rated Moderate, while Ex7 is rated Significant.

blocks.zh: 相同的自動化情境（8b vs. 7b）：Ex8 達到 Acceptable，而 Ex7 只到 Moderate。
blocks.en: Same automated scenario (8b vs. 7b): Ex8 reaches Acceptable, while Ex7 reaches only Moderate.

blocks.zh: 端對端自動化（8c vs. 7c）：Ex8 達到 Negligible，而 Ex7 只到 Acceptable。
blocks.en: End-to-end automation (8c vs. 7c): Ex8 reaches Negligible, while Ex7 reaches only Acceptable.

blocks.zh: 這完美示範了 9-Box 矩陣的邏輯：關鍵性越低，相同的控制措施能達到更低的最終弱點等級。
blocks.en: This is a perfect demonstration of the logic of the 9-Box matrix: the lower the criticality, the lower the final vulnerability rating that the same controls can achieve.

blocks.zh: 8c 特別亮點：備援過濾器 (Redundant Sterilizing Filters)
blocks.en: Highlight of 8c: redundant sterilizing filters

blocks.zh: Ex8c 的 GMP Process 特別提到「redundant sterilizing filters installed」——安裝了備援過濾器。這不僅是自動化，更是工程設計層面的風險降低：即使在線測試發現某支過濾器有問題，備援過濾器確保無菌屏障不中斷。這是從資料管控延伸到製程設計的整合思維。
blocks.en: The GMP process of Ex8c specifically mentions "redundant sterilizing filters installed". This goes beyond automation to risk reduction at the engineering design level: even if in-line testing finds a problem with one filter, the redundant filter ensures the sterile barrier is not interrupted. It is integrated thinking that extends from data control into process design.

blocks.zh: 比喻：起飛前輪胎確認 vs. 落地後檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: the pre-takeoff tire check vs. the post-landing check

blocks.zh: Pre-use 測試（Ex8）像飛機起飛前確認輪胎氣壓——是好的安全習慣（美國不強制、歐盟強制），但不像落地後檢查（Ex7）那樣直接確認「這趟飛行輪胎有沒有損壞」。因此即使紙本記錄方式相同，起飛前確認的資料關鍵性天然低於落地後確認。
blocks.en: Pre-use testing (Ex8) is like confirming tire pressure before the aircraft takes off: a good safety habit (not mandatory in the US, mandatory in the EU), but it does not directly confirm, as the post-landing check (Ex7) does, whether the tires were damaged on this flight. So even when the paper recording method is identical, the data criticality of the pre-takeoff check is inherently lower than that of the post-landing check.

blocks.zh: 您的產品是否同時銷往美國和歐盟？如果是，Ex8 的測試在您廠區應被視為中關鍵性還是高關鍵性？您的 DI 風險評估是否已針對不同目標市場分別設定控制要求？
blocks.en: Do your products ship to both the US and the EU? If so, should the Ex8 test at your site be treated as medium or high criticality? Has your DI risk assessment set separate control requirements for each target market?

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: Practical application for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 若服務歐盟客戶，Ex8 應提升至高關鍵性，對應控制措施需達到 Ex7b 或 7c 水準。建議在客戶技術協議 (Technical Agreement) 中明確列明過濾器完整性測試的資料管控標準，避免因監管要求差異造成稽核不符合。
blocks.en: If you serve EU clients, Ex8 should be raised to high criticality, and the corresponding controls need to reach the Ex7b or 7c level. We recommend stating the data control standard for filter integrity testing explicitly in the Technical Agreement with the client, to avoid audit non-compliance caused by differing regulatory requirements.

blocks.zh: Example 9: Low Criticality – Filter Identity Verification (Pre-Use, Pre-Sterilization) / 低關鍵性：使用前（滅菌前）過濾器身份驗證
blocks.en: Example 9: Low Criticality – Filter Identity Verification (Pre-Use, Pre-Sterilization)

blocks.zh: 低關鍵性的最大啟示：「夠好」比「最好」更重要
blocks.en: The biggest lesson of low criticality: "good enough" matters more than "the best"

blocks.zh: Ex9 的核心教訓是：低關鍵性資料不需要達到最高等級的控制。9a 用的是舊式紙本設備，但因為只是確認過濾器型號（不影響無菌性結論），加上「主管僅審查失敗案例」這個高強度控制，最終弱點等級就已經是 Acceptable。
blocks.en: The core lesson of Ex9 is that low-criticality data do not need the highest level of control. 9a uses legacy paper-based equipment, but because it only confirms the filter type (which does not affect the sterility conclusion), and because of the strong control "supervisor reviews failures only", the final vulnerability rating is already Acceptable.

blocks.zh: 9b 和 9c 都是 Negligible，但 TR84 明確指出 9c「理論上可行，但目前操作上不太可能實現」——這是 PDA 難得的務實聲明，提醒我們不必為低關鍵性資料追求最高技術層次。
blocks.en: Both 9b and 9c are Negligible, but TR84 states explicitly that 9c is "theoretically feasible but currently unlikely to be achieved in operation". This is a rare, pragmatic statement from PDA, reminding us that there is no need to pursue the highest technical level for low-criticality data.

blocks.zh: Ex7–9 對比總覽
blocks.en: Ex7–9 comparison overview

blocks.zh:
測試類型       關鍵性   紙本(a)        自動化(b)     全自動(c)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Ex7 使用後      高      Significant   Moderate      Acceptable
Ex8 使用前滅後  中      Moderate      Acceptable    Negligible
Ex9 身份驗證    低      Acceptable    Negligible    Negligible
blocks.en:
Test type     Criticality Paper (a)     Automated (b) Fully auto (c)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Ex7 Post-use  High        Significant   Moderate      Acceptable
Ex8 Pre-use   Medium      Moderate      Acceptable    Negligible
Ex9 Identity  Low         Acceptable    Negligible    Negligible

blocks.zh: 規律：關鍵性每降一級，相同控制措施的最終弱點等級也降一級。這是 9-Box 矩陣設計的數學邏輯。
blocks.en: Pattern: each step down in criticality lowers the final vulnerability rating by one level for the same controls. This is the mathematical logic behind the design of the 9-Box matrix.

blocks.zh: 資源分配警示
blocks.en: Resource allocation warning

blocks.zh: CDMO 的資本投資預算有限。Ex9 告訴我們：不要把有限資源用於升級低關鍵性資料的系統（例如把 9a 升到 9c）。應優先將資源投入把 7a 升到至少 7b——因為那才是患者安全直接相關的高關鍵性區域。
blocks.en: A CDMO's capital budget is limited. Ex9 tells us not to spend scarce resources upgrading systems for low-criticality data (for example, moving 9a to 9c). Priority should go to moving 7a to at least 7b, because that is the high-criticality area directly tied to patient safety.

blocks.zh: 您的廠區是否有將「身份驗證」與「使用後完整性確認」的過濾器測試記錄分開管理？如果混在同一個 SOP 裡，資料管控要求是否有明確區分，還是用同一個最高標準管理所有情境？
blocks.en: Does your site manage the filter test records for "identity verification" and "post-use integrity confirmation" separately? If they are mixed in the same SOP, are the data control requirements clearly differentiated, or is the same highest standard applied to every scenario?

blocks.zh: 建議建立過濾器測試資料關鍵性分級矩陣，標明每種測試的目的、法規依據、關鍵性等級與對應的最低可接受控制水準。這份矩陣可直接用於稽核準備，也可作為設備投資優先順序的決策依據。
blocks.en: We recommend building a data criticality classification matrix for filter testing that states, for each test, its purpose, regulatory basis, criticality level and the corresponding minimum acceptable control level. This matrix can be used directly for audit preparation and as a basis for prioritizing equipment investment.

blocks.zh: Tablet Packaging Process Examples — Overview / 藥錠包裝製程案例概述
blocks.en: Tablet Packaging Process Examples — Overview

blocks.zh: 8.4 節的設計邏輯：橫向掃描整個製程
blocks.en: Design logic of Section 8.4: scanning across the whole process

blocks.zh: 與 8.3 節（同一操作 × 三種技術層次）不同，8.4 節展示的是：同一個製程的七個步驟，各有不同的 DI 風險圖像。這更貼近真實稽核的思維——稽核員不是只看某一台設備，而是沿著生產流程找出最脆弱的環節。
blocks.en: Unlike Section 8.3 (one operation × three technology levels), Section 8.4 shows seven steps of one process, each with a different DI risk profile. This is closer to how a real audit thinks: an auditor does not look at a single piece of equipment, but follows the production flow to find the most fragile link.

blocks.zh: 七個步驟的弱點等級分佈：
blocks.en: Distribution of vulnerability ratings across the seven steps:

blocks.zh: 計畫 (10a)：Negligible
blocks.en: Planning (10a): Negligible

blocks.zh: 領料 (10b)：Significant
blocks.en: Dispensing (10b): Significant

blocks.zh: 清線 (10c)：Acceptable
blocks.en: Line clearance (10c): Acceptable

blocks.zh: 設備設置 (10d)：Significant
blocks.en: Equipment setup (10d): Significant

blocks.zh: 包裝操作 (10e)：Moderate
blocks.en: Packaging operation (10e): Moderate

blocks.zh: IPC 測試 (10f)：Acceptable
blocks.en: IPC testing (10f): Acceptable

blocks.zh: 批次核對 (10g)：Moderate
blocks.en: Batch reconciliation (10g): Moderate

blocks.zh: 比喻：餐廳的食品安全稽查
blocks.en: Analogy: a restaurant food safety inspection

blocks.zh: 稽查員不會只看廚房爐台——他們會從食材驗收、冷藏儲存、備料、烹飪到出餐全程掃描。8.4 節就是這種「全製程 DI 健康檢查」的示範，幫助品質主管找出哪些環節是真正的弱點，而不是把所有精力花在已經很安全的環節。
blocks.en: An inspector does not look only at the kitchen stove; they scan the whole chain from receipt of ingredients, cold storage and preparation to cooking and serving. Section 8.4 is a demonstration of this kind of "whole-process DI health check", helping quality managers find which steps are the real weak points instead of spending all their effort on steps that are already safe.

blocks.zh: 關鍵發現：試算表是包裝 DI 的頭號敵人
blocks.en: Key finding: spreadsheets are the number one enemy of packaging DI

blocks.zh: TR84 特別點名：使用試算表 (spreadsheet) 印出後交給領料團隊，是 10b 成為 Significant 的主因——試算表資料「在列印前可被輕易修改」。這個警告適用於所有還在使用 Excel 傳遞生產指令的 CDMO 操作。
blocks.en: TR84 specifically calls out the use of a spreadsheet that is printed and handed to the dispensing team as the main reason 10b is rated Significant: spreadsheet data "can easily be modified before printing". This warning applies to every CDMO operation that still uses Excel to pass on production instructions.

blocks.zh: Example 10: High & Medium Criticality – Tablet Packaging / 高與中關鍵性：藥錠包裝七步驟
blocks.en: Example 10: High & Medium Criticality – Tablet Packaging

blocks.zh: 10a — Planning（計畫）
blocks.en: 10a — Planning

blocks.zh: 10a：為何計畫階段達到 Negligible？
blocks.en: 10a: why does the planning stage reach Negligible?

blocks.zh: 驗證電子系統（如 SAP）自動將批次號傳入主批次記錄範本，將人工輸入批號的機會降至極低。關鍵 DI 弱點只剩一個例外情境：系統無法存取時允許手動填入批號。只要 SOP 嚴格限制此例外的使用條件並留有記錄，整體弱點維持在 Negligible。
blocks.en: A validated electronic system (such as SAP) transfers the batch number automatically into the master batch record template, reducing the chance of manually entering the batch number to a very low level. Only one exception scenario remains as a key DI vulnerability: manual entry of the batch number is allowed when the system cannot be accessed. As long as the SOP strictly limits the conditions for using this exception and a record is kept, the overall vulnerability stays at Negligible.

blocks.zh: 例外流程是 DI 破口
blocks.en: The exception process is a DI gap

blocks.zh: 「系統無法存取時允許手動操作」是許多廠商 SOP 的標準備用條款，但這個例外若未受控，將成為 DI 稽核的重點查核項目。建議：例外使用需主管授權 + 事後追溯記錄，並計入偏差管理。
blocks.en: "Manual operation is allowed when the system is inaccessible" is a standard fallback clause in many companies' SOPs, but if this exception is not controlled, it becomes a focus item in DI audits. Recommendation: require supervisor authorization for use of the exception, keep a retrospective record, and include it in deviation management.

blocks.zh: 10b — Dispensing（領料）
blocks.en: 10b — Dispensing

blocks.zh: 10b：試算表轉紙本是 DI 的高危路徑
blocks.en: 10b: spreadsheet-to-paper is a high-risk DI path

blocks.zh:
這是 TR84 最有實務警示意義的案例之一。問題不在於試算表本身，而在於「從驗證系統匯出 → 修改試算表 → 列印 → 交付操作員」這條資料鏈的中間環節完全不可追溯：
1. 誰修改了試算表？何時修改？
2. 列印版本與系統原始版本是否一致？
3. 操作員手抄到批次記錄時是否有誤？
任何一個環節出問題，高關鍵性的領料資料就已失去完整性。
blocks.en:
This is one of the most practically instructive cases in TR84. The problem is not the spreadsheet itself, but that the middle of the data chain "export from the validated system → modify the spreadsheet → print → hand to the operator" is completely untraceable:
1. Who modified the spreadsheet? When?
2. Is the printed version identical to the original system version?
3. Did the operator make errors when copying by hand into the batch record?
If any one of these links fails, the integrity of the high-criticality dispensing data is already lost.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院藥劑師手抄處方
blocks.en: Analogy: a hospital pharmacist copying prescriptions by hand

blocks.zh: 如果電子處方系統存在，但藥劑師還是要先把處方抄到紙上再照著配藥，這個「手抄」步驟就是 DI 風險的中心點。現代醫院早已從電子處方直接連到配藥機——包裝領料也應走同樣的直連路徑。
blocks.en: If an electronic prescribing system exists but the pharmacist still has to copy the prescription onto paper before compounding, this "hand copying" step is the center of the DI risk. Modern hospitals have long connected electronic prescribing directly to dispensing machines, and packaging dispensing should follow the same direct-connection path.

blocks.zh: CDMO 改善方向
blocks.en: CDMO improvement direction

blocks.zh: 最快改善：取消試算表中間步驟，直接從 ERP/MES 列印有唯一流水號的領料單（無法修改）。中期：導入條碼掃描確認物料身份 + 電子秤自動回寫重量至系統，消除手動記錄。
blocks.en: Fastest improvement: eliminate the intermediate spreadsheet step and print dispensing slips with unique serial numbers (which cannot be modified) directly from the ERP/MES. Medium term: introduce barcode scanning to confirm material identity + electronic balances that write weights back to the system automatically, eliminating manual recording.

blocks.zh: 10c — Line Clearance（生產線清線確認）
blocks.en: 10c — Line Clearance

blocks.zh: 10c：四眼原則 (Four-Eyes Check) 的 DI 價值
blocks.en: 10c: the DI value of the four-eyes check

blocks.zh: 生產線清線確認 (Line Clearance) 是高關鍵性操作，但透過即時雙人確認（四眼原則）+ 難清潔區域安裝感測器，即使是人工確認為主的方式，也能達到 Acceptable 弱點等級。
blocks.en: Line clearance is a high-criticality operation, but with real-time two-person verification (the four-eyes principle) + sensors installed in hard-to-clean areas, even a method that relies mainly on manual checks can reach an Acceptable vulnerability rating.

blocks.zh: 關鍵是「certified peer」——執行四眼複核的同儕需要通過認證，而非任意指派。這將人工控制的可靠性大幅提升。
blocks.en: The key is the "certified peer": the colleague who performs the four-eyes check must be certified, not assigned arbitrarily. This greatly increases the reliability of a manual control.

blocks.zh: 清線記錄的 DI 常見問題
blocks.en: Common DI problems in line clearance records

blocks.zh: 在執行前或執行後才填寫清線記錄（「預填」問題）
blocks.en: Completing the line clearance record before or after the activity (the "pre-filling" problem)

blocks.zh: 難以清潔的死角未列入清線 Checklist
blocks.en: Hard-to-clean dead spots not included in the line clearance checklist

blocks.zh: 感測器警報被操作員自行消除而未記錄
blocks.en: Sensor alarms cleared by the operator without being recorded

blocks.zh: 四眼複核只是形式，第二位簽名者未真正執行確認
blocks.en: The four-eyes check is a formality, and the second signer does not actually perform the check

blocks.zh: 您廠區的清線複核人員是否經過正式認證？認證是否包含實際操作評估，還是只有紙上訓練？如果複核人員未經認證，四眼原則的 DI 控制效力將大打折扣。
blocks.en: Are the line clearance verifiers at your site formally certified? Does certification include a practical assessment, or only paper-based training? If verifiers are not certified, the DI control effectiveness of the four-eyes principle is greatly weakened.

blocks.zh: 10d — Equipment Setup（設備設置）
blocks.en: 10d — Equipment Setup

blocks.zh: 10d：群組帳號是 DI 的重大漏洞
blocks.en: 10d: group accounts are a major DI loophole

blocks.zh: 這是 TR84 最直接的 DI 警示之一。群組帳號 (group accounts) 讓多個操作員共用同一個登入身份，完全違反了 DI 的可追溯性 (traceability) 原則——當設定被修改時，系統無法識別是哪位具體的操作員做的。
blocks.en: This is one of the most direct DI warnings in TR84. Group accounts let several operators share one login identity, which completely violates the DI principle of traceability: when a setting is changed, the system cannot identify which individual operator did it.

blocks.zh: 更嚴重的問題：操作員可以把容忍範圍（如視覺檢查的判定閾值）調寬以降低拒絕率——這是直接影響產品品質的資料造假動機。
blocks.en: A more serious problem: operators can widen tolerance ranges (such as the acceptance thresholds for visual inspection) to lower the rejection rate. This is a data falsification incentive that directly affects product quality.

blocks.zh: 比喻：共用的門禁卡
blocks.en: Analogy: a shared access card

blocks.zh: 如果整個生產部門共用一張門禁卡，事後發現某個房間的設備被動過，卻無法確定是誰進去操作——這正是群組帳號在 DI 稽核中的問題。「帳號個人化」不是 IT 部門的便利選擇，而是 GMP 基本要求。
blocks.en: If the whole production department shares one access card and equipment in a room is later found to have been tampered with, there is no way to tell who went in. That is exactly the problem with group accounts in a DI audit. "Individual accounts" are not a convenience choice for the IT department; they are a basic GMP requirement.

blocks.zh: CDMO 優先改善項目
blocks.en: CDMO priority improvement items

blocks.zh: 立即行動：稽核所有包裝設備的帳號設置，確認每位操作員有個人帳號。中期：為 CPP 相關設定（配方選擇、容忍範圍）增加修改前主管授權步驟，並在稽核軌跡中記錄授權人資訊。
blocks.en: Immediate action: audit the account setup of all packaging equipment and confirm that every operator has an individual account. Medium term: add a supervisor authorization step before changes to CPP-related settings (recipe selection, tolerance ranges), and record the authorizer's information in the audit trail.

blocks.zh: 10e — Packaging Operation（包裝操作）
blocks.en: 10e — Packaging Operation

blocks.zh: 10e：稽核軌跡讓 Significant 降至 Moderate
blocks.en: 10e: the audit trail moves Significant down to Moderate

blocks.zh: 10e 的設備設置問題（群組帳號、可調整容忍範圍）與 10d 類似，但弱點等級從 Significant 降至 Moderate，原因在於：稽核軌跡自動記錄所有設定點和容忍範圍的變更，並納入批次報告。
blocks.en: The equipment setup issues of 10e (group accounts, adjustable tolerance ranges) are similar to those of 10d, but the vulnerability rating falls from Significant to Moderate, because the audit trail automatically records all changes to setpoints and tolerance ranges and includes them in the batch report.

blocks.zh: 這意味著雖然操作員仍可修改設定，但任何修改都留有完整記錄，事後品質審查時可追溯。這正是稽核軌跡 (Audit Trail) 的 DI 控制價值所在。
blocks.en: This means that although operators can still change settings, every change leaves a complete record that can be traced during later quality review. This is exactly the DI control value of the audit trail.

blocks.zh: 「拒絕品重新加回」的 DI 問題
blocks.en: The DI problem of "adding rejects back"

blocks.zh: 操作員將不合格品（rejects）放回包裝線是最嚴重的 DI 違規之一。這不只是 GMP 違規，而是直接危害患者安全的行為。TR84 提醒：系統設計應物理上防止拒絕品重新進入生產線，而不只是靠 SOP 禁止。
blocks.en: An operator putting rejects back onto the packaging line is one of the most serious DI violations. It is not only a GMP violation but an act that directly endangers patient safety. TR84 reminds us that the system design should physically prevent rejects from re-entering the line, rather than relying only on an SOP prohibition.

blocks.zh: 您的包裝設備是否有稽核軌跡功能？稽核軌跡是否覆蓋所有可調整的 CPP 設定點和感測器容忍範圍？最後一次確認稽核軌跡完整性是什麼時候？
blocks.en: Does your packaging equipment have an audit trail function? Does the audit trail cover all adjustable CPP setpoints and sensor tolerance ranges? When did you last verify the integrity of the audit trail?

blocks.zh: 10f — In-Process Control Testing（製程中控制測試）
blocks.en: 10f — In-Process Control Testing

blocks.zh: 10f：「可重新列印」的設備如何管控？
blocks.en: 10f: how do you control equipment that can "reprint"?

blocks.zh: IPC 測試設備允許重印舊測試結果（reprint），這本身是一個 DI 風險——操作員可能用舊列印紙替換當次測試結果。控制措施：操作員簽名覆蓋在列印紙上（簽名跨越紙邊與批次記錄頁面），使替換變得可見。
blocks.en: IPC test equipment that allows old test results to be reprinted is itself a DI risk: an operator might substitute an old printout for the current test result. The control: the operator's signature is overlaid on the printout (the signature crosses the edge of the paper and the batch record page), making any substitution visible.

blocks.zh: 關鍵保護：操作員無法修改設備上的時間和日期（此權限保留給管理員），列印紙上的時間戳記因此成為可信的原始資料。
blocks.en: Key safeguard: operators cannot change the time and date on the equipment (this privilege is reserved for administrators), so the timestamp on the printout becomes trustworthy raw data.

blocks.zh: 「無批次資訊的列印紙」是 DI 弱點
blocks.en: "Printouts without batch information" are a DI weakness

blocks.zh: 如果列印紙只有時間、日期和結果，而沒有批次號、產品名、操作員 ID，那麼這張列印紙理論上可以被用在任何批次。這是許多老舊 IPC 設備的常見問題。建議在列印紙貼附時同時手寫批次相關資訊，或升級至能列印完整批次資訊的設備。
blocks.en: If a printout shows only the time, date and result, without the batch number, product name or operator ID, then in theory it could be used for any batch. This is a common problem with many older IPC instruments. We recommend also handwriting the batch-related information when attaching the printout, or upgrading to equipment that prints full batch information.

blocks.zh: 稽核您的 IPC 設備：哪些設備允許重印？時間日期設定是否有存取控制？列印紙是否包含足夠的批次識別資訊？針對只能重印而無電子記錄的設備，建立明確的貼附和簽名規範，並在 SOP 中說明防偽措施。
blocks.en: Audit your IPC equipment: which units allow reprinting? Is there access control over the time and date settings? Do printouts carry enough batch identification information? For equipment that can only reprint and has no electronic record, establish clear rules for attachment and signature, and describe the anti-falsification measures in the SOP.

blocks.zh: 10g — Batch Reconciliation（批次核對）
blocks.en: 10g — Batch Reconciliation

blocks.zh: 10g：批次核對的 DI 風險地圖
blocks.en: 10g: the DI risk map of batch reconciliation

blocks.zh:
批次核對 (Batch Reconciliation) 是高關鍵性操作（影響患者安全），但弱點等級為 Moderate 而非 Significant，主要得益於：
1. 設備自動生成批次結束報告
2. 報告範本和資料鎖定，任何人無法修改內容
這兩個控制措施有效限制了資料事後竄改的可能性。
blocks.en:
Batch reconciliation is a high-criticality operation (it affects patient safety), but its vulnerability rating is Moderate rather than Significant, mainly thanks to:
1. The equipment generates the end-of-batch report automatically
2. The report template and data are locked, so no one can modify the content
These two controls effectively limit the possibility of after-the-fact data tampering.

blocks.zh: 剩餘弱點在於：包裝材料核對完全是手動過程（手寫日誌），且操作員理論上可以提前結束批次或把拒絕品放回線上——這些風險目前只靠同儕雙重驗證控制。
blocks.en: The remaining vulnerability is that reconciliation of packaging materials is entirely manual (a handwritten log), and in theory an operator could end a batch early or put rejects back on the line. These risks are currently controlled only by peer double verification.

blocks.zh: 比喻：銀行出納的日終對帳
blocks.en: Analogy: a bank teller's end-of-day reconciliation

blocks.zh: 批次核對就像銀行出納在關帳前清點現金——如果允許出納自己記帳而沒有系統自動核對，造假就很容易。10g 的改善方向（用條碼掃描替換手寫日誌）就像銀行升級到 ATM 自動計鈔，不再靠人手點鈔。
blocks.en: Batch reconciliation is like a bank teller counting cash before closing: if tellers are allowed to keep their own books with no automatic system reconciliation, falsification is easy. The improvement direction for 10g (replacing the handwritten log with barcode scanning) is like a bank upgrading to an ATM that counts notes automatically, no longer relying on counting by hand.

blocks.zh: 您廠區的批次核對是否仍在使用手寫日誌記錄包裝材料使用量？如果是，日誌的填寫時機（即時 vs. 批次結束後回填）是否受到監控？回填記錄是 DI 稽核的高頻查核點。
blocks.en: Does your site still use a handwritten log to record packaging material usage in batch reconciliation? If so, is the timing of entries (real time vs. back-filled at the end of the batch) monitored? Back-filled records are a high-frequency check point in DI audits.

blocks.zh: CDMO 改善建議
blocks.en: CDMO improvement recommendation

blocks.zh: 將包裝材料日誌由手寫升級為條碼掃描 + 電子系統記錄，每次取用新一批包材時自動記錄時間戳記和操作員 ID。這個改善可將 10g 從 Moderate 降至 Acceptable，同時大幅減少核對計算錯誤。
blocks.en: Upgrade the packaging material log from handwriting to barcode scanning + electronic system records, automatically recording the timestamp and operator ID each time a new lot of packaging material is drawn. This improvement can lower 10g from Moderate to Acceptable, while greatly reducing reconciliation calculation errors.

blocks.zh: References for Appendix I / 附錄一參考文獻
blocks.en: References for Appendix I

blocks.zh: 兩份監管文件的關鍵差異（本節相關）
blocks.en: Key differences between the two regulatory documents (relevant to this section)

blocks.zh: FDA 2004 無菌加工指引：使用後過濾器完整性測試為常規要求；使用前測試「可執行」但非法規要求。
blocks.en: FDA 2004 Aseptic Processing Guidance: post-use filter integrity testing is a routine requirement; pre-use testing is "performable" but not a regulatory requirement.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1（2017 諮詢版，現行版為 2022）：使用前和使用後都必須確認過濾器完整性。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 (2017 consultation draft; the current version is 2022): filter integrity must be confirmed both before and after use.

blocks.zh: 注意：本報告引用的是 2017 諮詢文件版本；現行 EU Annex 1 已於 2022 年 8 月發布，2023 年 8 月生效，CDMO 應以最新版本為準。
blocks.en: Note: this report cites the 2017 consultation version; the current EU Annex 1 was published in August 2022 and became effective in August 2023, and a CDMO should work to the latest version.

blocks.zh: 法規版本更新提醒
blocks.en: Reminder on regulatory version updates

blocks.zh: TR84 發布於 2020 年，引用的 Annex 1 為 2017 年諮詢版。現行 Annex 1 (2022) 在過濾器完整性、資料完整性和汙染控制方面有更詳細的要求。建議對照最新 Annex 1 重新審視本節案例的適用性。
blocks.en: TR84 was published in 2020 and cites the 2017 consultation draft of Annex 1. The current Annex 1 (2022) has more detailed requirements on filter integrity, data integrity and contamination control. We recommend re-examining the applicability of the cases in this section against the latest Annex 1.

blocks.zh: 總結
blocks.en: Summary

blocks.zh: 章節總結 — Section 6b Summary
blocks.en: Section 6b Summary

blocks.zh: 核心洞察與 CDMO 行動指引
blocks.en: Core insights and action guidance for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察一：資料關鍵性決定可接受的最低控制層次
blocks.en: Key insight 1: data criticality determines the minimum acceptable level of control

blocks.zh: Ex7–9 清楚示範：同樣的紙本記錄方式，在高關鍵性情境（Ex7a）導致 Significant 弱點，在低關鍵性情境（Ex9a）只導致 Acceptable 弱點。這告訴我們，DI 控制不是「越嚴越好」，而是要與資料關鍵性相稱。過度控制低關鍵性資料是資源浪費；控制不足高關鍵性資料是合規風險。
blocks.en: Ex7–9 clearly demonstrate that the same paper recording method leads to a Significant vulnerability in a high-criticality scenario (Ex7a) but only an Acceptable vulnerability in a low-criticality scenario (Ex9a). This tells us that DI control is not "the stricter the better" but must be commensurate with data criticality. Over-controlling low-criticality data wastes resources; under-controlling high-criticality data is a compliance risk.

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察二：自動化是降低 DI 弱點最有效的系統性工具
blocks.en: Key insight 2: automation is the most effective systematic tool for reducing DI vulnerability

blocks.zh: 在所有九個無菌充填案例（Ex7–9）中，從紙本（a）到自動化（b）到全自動化（c）的路徑，弱點等級穩定下降一到兩個等級。這不是巧合——自動化同時解決了三個弱點因子：減少人為介入、確保資料完整傳輸、建立不可竄改的儲存記錄。
blocks.en: Across all nine aseptic filling cases (Ex7–9), the path from paper (a) to automated (b) to fully automated (c) steadily lowers the vulnerability rating by one to two levels. This is no coincidence: automation addresses three vulnerability factors at once by reducing human intervention, ensuring complete data transfer and creating tamper-proof storage records.

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察三：包裝製程的 DI 風險集中在「轉換節點」
blocks.en: Key insight 3: DI risk in the packaging process is concentrated at "conversion nodes"

blocks.zh: Ex10 的 Significant 弱點（10b 領料、10d 設備設置）都發生在資料從一個系統「轉換」到另一個形式的節點：試算表列印、群組帳號修改設置。消除這些轉換節點（直接系統連接、個人帳號、稽核軌跡）是包裝 DI 管控的優先策略。
blocks.en: The Significant vulnerabilities in Ex10 (10b dispensing, 10d equipment setup) both occur at nodes where data are "converted" from one system to another form: printing a spreadsheet, and changing settings through a group account. Eliminating these conversion nodes (direct system connection, individual accounts, audit trails) is the priority strategy for packaging DI control.

blocks.zh: CDMO 最高優先行動清單
blocks.en: CDMO top-priority action list

blocks.zh: 立即：稽核所有過濾器完整性測試儀，確認使用後測試（高關鍵性）有電子稽核軌跡，紙本列印貼附方式符合防替換要求。
blocks.en: Immediate: audit all filter integrity testers, confirm that post-use testing (high criticality) has an electronic audit trail, and that the way paper printouts are attached meets the anti-substitution requirement.

blocks.zh: 立即：消除包裝領料流程中的試算表中間步驟，或至少建立試算表版本控制和列印後鎖定機制。
blocks.en: Immediate: eliminate the intermediate spreadsheet step in the packaging dispensing process, or at least establish spreadsheet version control and a lock-after-print mechanism.

blocks.zh: 短期：確保所有包裝設備操作員有個人帳號，移除或嚴格限制群組帳號的使用。
blocks.en: Short term: make sure every packaging equipment operator has an individual account, and remove or strictly limit the use of group accounts.

blocks.zh: 中期：為包裝材料核對導入條碼掃描系統，替代手寫日誌。
blocks.en: Medium term: introduce a barcode scanning system for packaging material reconciliation to replace the handwritten log.

blocks.zh: 中期：評估服務市場（FDA / EMA）對過濾器完整性測試的差異要求，在技術協議中明確規範。
blocks.en: Medium term: evaluate the differing filter integrity testing requirements of the markets you serve (FDA / EMA) and specify them explicitly in the Technical Agreement.

blocks.zh: 本節核心比喻總結
blocks.en: Summary of the core analogies in this section

blocks.zh: TR84 Section 6b 的十個案例就像一份「製藥製程 DI 地圖」——標出了哪些地方是高海拔險峻山路（高關鍵性 + 高弱點），哪些是平緩低地（低關鍵性 + 低弱點）。聰明的 CDMO 不是把整條路都修成八線高速公路，而是在山路上建護欄、在懸崖邊設路障，在平地上維持一般道路標準——以最有效率的資源配置確保整體旅程安全。
blocks.en: The ten cases in TR84 Section 6b are like a "DI map of the pharmaceutical process": it marks which stretches are steep high-altitude mountain roads (high criticality + high vulnerability) and which are gentle lowlands (low criticality + low vulnerability). A smart CDMO does not turn the whole road into an eight-lane expressway; it builds guardrails on the mountain road, puts barriers at the cliff edge, and keeps ordinary road standards on flat ground, so that the whole journey is kept safe with the most efficient allocation of resources.
